name: Touma Riito
source:
2nd year high school student.
The protagonist's childhood friend and neighbor since kindergarten.
But it's a bit of an undesirable relationship and they always seem to fight about things.
He's a confident guy who can get along with most people really easily.
But he also has a bad habit of sticking his nose into other people's business and getting into trouble.

The five personality's you can switch him between are, 'energetic', 'do-S', 'ore-sama', 'intelligent', and 'gentleman'.
